# `nlink-lab node rm`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Remove nodes, and everything attached to them: links (both ends), impairments, network memberships, dependencies, WireGuard peers

Usage: nlink-lab node rm [OPTIONS] <NAMES>...

Arguments:
  <NAMES>...
          

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --dry-run
          Show the plan; change nothing

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
